resources.string: Exact answers to calculations in your question, instantly and without the model.

• A battery's watt-hours, and whether it can fly
• Fuel economy: L/100 km and miles per gallon
• Hiking time by Naismith's rule
• Currency at the rate you give, with a tip
• Water for a trip: people × days × litres
• Temperature: Celsius and Fahrenheit
• How long: an amount at a rate (MB at MB/s, km at km/h, pages per hour)
• How many: containers, trips or buses for a total, rounded up
I have 23 L of water and 5 L jerrycans. How many jerrycans do I need?
How long to drive 240 miles at 60 mph?
My power bank is 5,000 mAh at 3.85 V. How many watt-hours is that, and can I take it on a plane?

It works out the answer from the numbers in your question and shows the formula. Anything else goes to the model as usual. A message about health, an injury, danger or a person (or a chat that was) never gets a calculator answer. The answer\'s details say Tool when the calculator wrote it. Word problems are English only. Ported from r4to\'s calculator (BOAR R&D).
